data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A genetic algorithm initialized with Batcher's 48-comparator network and pruned via the 0-1 principle can discover a structurally novel 45-comparator network.","counterconditions":[{"case":"Local search might get trapped in the basin of attraction of the 48-comparator network and fail to find a valid 45-comparator configuration.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The deterministic sandbox limits might restrict population size and generations too much for the GA to converge.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"By iteratively removing one comparator from the best known network and using local search (swapping endpoints, shifting positions) to fix the 0-1 sorting violations, the algorithm can traverse local minima better than strict BFS and find a valid 45-comparator configuration.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
